-- M/M-rt/src/C.java --
class C { static class Cfg { int n = 2; long tMs = 1500L; } }
-- M/M-rt/src/BA.java --
@NiagaraType
@NiagaraProperty(name = "n", type = "int", defaultValue = "2")
@NiagaraProperty(name = "t", type = "BRelTime", defaultValue = "BRelTime.make(1500)")
class BA { void f(C.Cfg c) { c.n = getN(); c.tMs = getT().getMillis(); } }
